executor_result.summary: Add DefiLlama aggregate live run_once scoring integration regression test proving DefiLlamaStablecoinCollector integration, PIT semantics, and evidence health outputs

instructions: TEST-ONLY. Add exactly part2/capital_flow/tests/test_defillama_live_scoring_integration.py; do not modify production code or any other file. Prove the already registered DefiLlamaStablecoinCollector path through runner.run_once(network=True, include_backfill=False) using a deterministic JSON chart fixture, not network. Use as_of_ms=1787054400000 (2026-08-18 12:00 UTC), dates 1786665600 (2026-08-14 00:00 UTC) and 1786924800 (2026-08-17 00:00 UTC), values 100000000000 and 101000000000, e.g. [{"date":1786665600,"totalCirculatingUSD":{"peggedUSD":100000000000}},{"date":1786924800,"totalCirculatingUSD":{"peggedUSD":101000000000}}]. Patch runner.DefiLlamaStablecoinCollector to a small collector whose collect(observed_at_ms,include_backfill) delegates to DefiLlamaStablecoinCollector.parse_json(json.dumps(fixture), observed_at_ms=observed_at_ms, include_backfill=include_backfill); patch the other eight default runner collectors to return []. Use tmp_path local_dir. Assert defillama_stablecoin collection_attempt status OK, observation_count 1, source_errors [], appended_observations 1, archive_records_loaded 1, scoring_records_loaded 1. Read result['paths']['archive'] with load_observations: exactly one stablecoin/supply_usd source defillama_stablecoins value 101000000000 unit USD asset USD_STABLECOINS, effective_at_ms=1786924800000, available_at_ms=observed_at_ms=1787054400000, revision='1787054400000', provenance NOT context_only. Assert result['anata_output']['families']['stablecoin']['scoring_observation_count']==1, ['context_observation_count']==0, ['scoring_latest_effective_at_ms']==1786924800000 and scoring_latest_available_at_ms==1787054400000. Assert anata_output['source_evidence'] has stablecoin/defillama_stablecoins role scoring, three latest clocks, clock_provenance effective/availability/observed revision matching observed; evidence_health['collection']['successful_collectors'] includes defillama_stablecoin; evidence_health['families']['stablecoin'] scoring_observation_count=1, scoring_latest_effective_at_ms=1786924800000, scoring_latest_available_at_ms=1787054400000, scoring_effective_age_seconds=129600.0 and scoring_availability_age_seconds=0.0. Read result['paths']['audit_latest'] with json.load; audit['context_only_observation_count']==0. No top-level anata_output['context_only_observation_count'] exists. Optional PIT guard: call run_once(local_dir=same_tmp_path,network=False,as_of_ms=1787054399999) and assert handoff stablecoin scoring_observation_count==0 and no stablecoin source_evidence; do NOT expect scoring_records_loaded==0 because archived scoring rows remain loaded but are causally invisible before first receipt. Do not demand non-null family scores from one row. Preserve frozen scoring, context-only isolation, scoring-only freshness, revision identity, source PIT, and missingness. This is NOT a Farside retry.
